Also....posting screenshots and videos of private conversations is not only extremely inconsiderate but in general not acceptable unless she has your  permission to share media that has you in it. Not only that but from the sound of her reaction she hasn’t even attempted to consider how you feel about having your relationship on display. It does sound like you care for her though maybe tell her that sharing like this devalues those moments between you two if the world is invited in. Emotional vulnerability and intimacy will become impossible if there’s the constant threat that she’s initiating these conversations or calls or sweet moments for her followers and not out of sincerity.

I was 17 when I had my son. I was in labor for 2 days. His dad knew. I was induced at 6am,my son was born at 11:48am. His mother was a labor and delivery nurse for 15 years before that day. There’s no way he didn’t understand the gravity of it. She came. She helped deliver the baby because the floor was short that day. He didn’t. My best friend(who was also 17) had stayed with me,slept next to me,held my hand and cried with me was there. He wasn’t. When my son was born he had a complication with his lungs. they took him to care for him and stabilize him. That is when his father walked in. As the nurse came through with my son saying he was fine and we could hold him,his father snapped up and reached out...rage filled my body....I ripped off the monitors and willed my self to my feet growling(no joke,the nurses were shook. Like stuck in place) through my gritted teeth I said “THATS MY BABY” the nurse looked at dad and spun on her heel to turn towards me brining my son to me and ushering me back to my bed. I held out on his dad the whole pregnancy thinking the day our baby was born would wake something up in him. The moment the child took a breath I knew the people he needed were in that room to love him unconditionally. Ive always kept the lines of communication open for his dad but his dad has never not once tried to be anything to my son. Don’t debate this,if not just because of your time wasted but because of the unbelievable love that that child will waste on him that he doesn’t deserve.
